answers.Provide examples of when this employee w: Anisah’s customer service is genuinely 10/10. She has an amazing bubbly personality that customers naturally gravitate towards, and her smile is infectious. She consistently approaches customers with warmth and enthusiasm and creates a welcoming atmosphere for everyone she serves. Even when managing her own section, she remains attentive and engaging with her customers. Her positive energy doesn’t just improve the experience of our guests, but also lifts the mood of the team around her. Customer interaction has always been one of her strongest qualities and she represents the friendly and welcoming service we want to provide at M11 extremely well.

Anisah has shown an immense amount of improvement in her efficiency and time management since joining us in March. She is now able to lock in and focus on managing her section effectively whilst simultaneously keeping on top of other responsibilities such as preparing chopsticks and napkins. What has particularly impressed me is the improvement in her ability to think ahead. For example, she now anticipates when we are going to run out of something and asks KP for a new load before it happens. This allows her to remain prepared, reduces interruptions during service and means other team members don’t have to step away from their own sections to assist her. She has become significantly more independent and organised during service, and the progress she has made through consistently asking questions, taking feedback on board and actively working to improve has been amazing to see.
answers.Describe a time when this employee demon: Anisah is always willing and ready to support the people around her, particularly during busy services. When she is running and isn’t responsible for her own section, she is constantly looking for ways to help the rest of the team. In between running food, she will clear tables for team members, help pack Deliveroo orders and step in to greet and seat guests if the host is momentarily occupied. What stands out to me is that she never has the attitude of “that isn’t my job”. If she can see that somebody needs support, she is happy to jump in and help wherever she can. This takes pressure off the rest of the FOH team and helps us maintain a smooth service even when several areas of the restaurant are busy at the same time.
answers.Give us an example of when the employee: Anisah has become really good at recognising what needs to be done without always needing to be directed. A great example is when she is running food during a busy service. Rather than standing and waiting for the next dishes to come up, she uses that time to look around the restaurant and identify where she can help. She may clear and reset a table for another server, pack a Deliveroo order that is waiting or notice guests waiting at the entrance and seat them if the host is busy. She has also developed the initiative to anticipate things before they become an issue, such as noticing when we are running low on chopsticks or napkins and arranging for more before we completely run out. This growing awareness of not just her own responsibilities but what the wider team and restaurant need has been one of the biggest improvements I’ve seen in her.
answers.Give an example that best supports this: Anisah consistently demonstrates a really strong work ethic and can-do attitude. She comes into her shifts ready to work and is always looking for ways she can contribute. She actively asks for feedback on how she can improve and, rather than becoming discouraged when something takes her longer to learn, she puts the time and effort into developing until she gets it. This has been one of the biggest areas of improvement I’ve seen in her , she is increasingly thinking ahead and taking responsibility for what needs to happen next rather than waiting to be asked.
answers.Has this employee ever missed a shift or: There have been occasions where Anisah has been unable to attend a shift or has been running late, however what stands out is the level of responsibility and communication she demonstrates when this happens. She always lets me know in advance and, where she is unable to attend, she will often come to me having already found a potential solution by asking another team member if they are available to cover her shift, before checking with me that the change is okay. Similarly, if she knows she is going to be late, she communicates this in advance and keeps me informed rather than leaving the management team unaware. She is also willing to stay later where needed to make up the time. Outside of this, Anisah is one of our most reliable team members. She regularly looks for additional shifts, is often one of the first to accept extra hours and is extremely willing to step in when another member of the team calls in sick. Her communication, accountability and willingness to find solutions make her someone I can genuinely rely on.
answers.Describe a time when the employee delive: Anisah has made significant progress in the quality and consistency of her work since joining us. Anisah still has areas to develop, particularly maintaining her confidence and accuracy under pressure, but the progress she has made through her own effort is exactly why I believe she deserves recognition this month.
